cards.title: Exam answer plan: why the League of Nations failed
cards.problem: Give reasons for the failure of the League of Nations.

steps.text: Major powers were absent: the USA never joined; Germany and the USSR joined late.
It had no army and depended on sanctions, which members did not enforce.

cards.answer: It failed to stop aggression: Japan in Manchuria (1931), Italy in Ethiopia (1935).

cards.title: 8.2 The Great Depression
body: At the end of 1920s and throughout 1930s, the economies of Western countries collapsed.
The Great Depression had big negative consequences on the social, economic, and political conditions of western countries.

questions.q: Identify the wrong statement concerning the Nazi party.

options.A: The party denied the Jews the right to German citizenship.
options.B: The party was involved in the creation of Great Germany.
options.C: The party was involved in the abolition of the Treaty of Versailles.
options.D: The party brought socio-economic reform to German workers.

why: The textbook: the Nazis took away the Jews' German citizenship (Nuremberg Laws 1935); aimed to create a Greater Germany (Austria, Sudetenland); tore up the Treaty of Versailles (rearmament, Rhineland); and public works and rearmament ended unemployment, with welfare programmes for workers.
All four are true of the Nazi party. Answer: E.
